What you will be doing

As a Foam Technician, you will work with foam and plastic materials used to protect fragile high-tech components. You will assemble different parts into finished protection solutions, following technical drawings and clear work instructions.

Accuracy is important in this role, so you will measure dimensions, check tolerances and inspect the finishing of the products to make sure everything meets the required specifications. If you notice a deviation or something that could be improved, you will report it to the right colleagues.

Your day-to-day work will include:

- Assembling foam and plastic components according to technical drawings and work instructions.
- Measuring dimensions and checking tolerances.
- Inspecting the quality and finishing of completed products.
- Identifying and reporting deviations or possible improvements.
- Handling and processing different foam and plastic materials.
- Working together with colleagues from production and logistics.
- Keeping your workplace clean, organised and safe.

You will work Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Afternoon shift: 15:00 – 00:00

Weekend overtime is also possible and is paid at an increased rate when applicable.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who is practical, technically minded and ready to build something long term. You should feel comfortable working with materials, tools and technical instructions.

For this position, we are looking for:

- English at B2/C1 level: good enough to follow instructions, ask questions and communicate comfortably at work.
- Previous experience working with plastics, preferably in plastic processing or plastic welding.
- Comfortable working from technical drawings and using them to carry out your work accurately.
- Available to work in two shifts, alternating between morning and evening shifts.
- You pay attention to the details and take pride in delivering work that meets the required qu
